resources.string: Device spike harness for the on-device 3D scan. Debug builds only; it is not in the release app.

Before you start: let the phone cool down, use good even light, and keep Depth on. Timing numbers from a debug build are only approximate.

1. Carton (about 60 × 40 × 40 cm) at about 0.7 m: 5 scans. Measure the carton with a tape first and type W, H and D below. Label: carton-0.7m.
2. The same carton at about 1.5 m: 5 scans, same tape values. Label: carton-1.5m.
3. An armchair: 5 scans (tape it). Label: armchair.
4. A 2–3-seat sofa: 5 scans (tape it). Label: sofa.

Each scan: mark the box (3 base corners, then a point on top), tap Start 3D capture, and walk slowly all the way round the object at the stated distance for 45–90 s. Capture stops by itself at 90 s; otherwise tap Finish. Note any holes or odd results.

Do at least one full 90 s scan from a cool start (thermal check). Repeat on a second phone if you have one, ideally one with smoothed-only depth.

When all runs are done, tap Share all results and send the CSV.
